column1: # Titles flagged by check-layout.py's title-policy check (STYLE.md rule 14)
# that a person has read and judged fine. The heuristic is dumb on purpose --
# no digit, colon, comma or em-dash, and five words or more -- so most of what
# it flags will be fine, and this list is where that judgment is recorded.
# The first field is the exact YAML title. Delete a line to see it again.
